messages.text:
We propose a limited exception to the copying and disclosure restrictions so the festival can review the unfinished cut and prepare catalog copy if selected.

Four festival programmers and one outside accessibility reviewer would have access to the screener solely for review. Each would agree in writing to keep the film confidential and prevent onward sharing. Two programmers would each be allowed one offline copy on encrypted equipment. The other three reviewers would stream the film. We would delete the offline copies and disable screener access when review ends. The platform retains a backup for 30 days after removal. We request permission for that retention period, with the backup unavailable to reviewers.

A programmer could give the selection board a short oral synopsis in a closed session. Board members would keep it confidential and would receive no screener or clips.

If selected, we request permission for the catalog editor to draft an entry in confidence and publish it no earlier than the festival’s official selection announcement, even if the film’s public release comes later. If you need approval of the wording, we can send the draft for written sign-off and hold publication until both sign-off and announcement.

Can you approve these review arrangements and confirm whether the catalog entry needs separate sign-off?

We can agree a limited review exception, but not on the terms as proposed. Approvals still open are named access, watermarking, deletion evidence, backup handling, synopsis limits, and publicity sign-off.

Review access is acceptable only for five named individuals: the four programmers and the outside accessibility reviewer, each identified in writing before any access, each signing a confidentiality undertaking that bars onward sharing, notes that identify plot outcomes, and any disclosure of unannounced cast appearances. Access is solely for programming review and accessibility assessment. Please send the names. Unnamed or substitute reviewers are not cleared.

Every screener, stream, and offline copy must carry a visible, unique watermark identifying the viewer. Two named programmers may each hold one offline copy on encrypted equipment. The other three must stream only. Offline copies and streaming access end when review ends, or sooner if we withdraw the cut. Deletion is not complete until you send a written deletion record for each offline copy, stating who held it, the device, the deletion time, and confirmation that no further copies remain. A platform backup is acceptable only if it is inaccessible to reviewers and staff, encrypted, and purged within 72 hours of review end. We do not accept a 30-day retention. If we withdraw the cut, disable access the same day and purge backups and offline copies within 72 hours, with the same deletion record.

A short oral synopsis in a closed selection-board session is acceptable only if it does not disclose the ending or any unannounced cast appearance, and if board members receive no screener, clip, or written synopsis and are bound to keep even that limited account confidential. Please confirm the board will not be told those two points.

Catalog and other publicity excerpts need separate written sign-off. You may draft an entry in confidence after selection. Send the draft; we will clear or reject it within two business days. Publication may occur only after both our written approval and your official selection announcement, and never before. If we withdraw the cut before announcement, the draft is not published and is deleted. No clips or excerpts without the same approval.

Confirm names, watermarking, the 72-hour purge and deletion record, synopsis limits, and the sign-off timeline, and we can close the exception.

The festival accepts the named-access terms. We still owe you the five names in writing, including which two programmers need offline copies. We’ll hold access until you’ve cleared those individuals and all five have signed undertakings limiting use to programming review and accessibility assessment and barring onward sharing, notes identifying plot outcomes, and disclosure of unannounced cast appearances. Any substitute requires fresh clearance.

We’ll require a visible watermark unique to the viewer on every stream and offline copy. Each of the two designated programmers may keep one copy on encrypted equipment. The other three reviewers will stream only. At review end we’ll disable access and delete both offline copies. If you withdraw the cut earlier, we’ll disable access that day and delete the offline copies within 72 hours. For each copy we’ll send a written record identifying the holder, device and deletion time, with the holder’s confirmation that they retain no further copy.

**The platform’s 30-day backup prevents us from confirming a 72-hour purge.** We’ll hold the upload. Can you provide a screening platform that supports individually watermarked streams and the two encrypted offline copies, with any backup encrypted, inaccessible to reviewers and staff, and purged within 72 hours of review end or withdrawal? We’ll verify those controls before using it. If a suitable platform is unavailable, review remains pending.

The selection board will hear only a short oral synopsis in a closed, confidential session. We’ll omit both the ending and any unannounced cast appearance. Board members will be bound to confidentiality and receive no screener, clip or written synopsis.

If selected, we may draft the catalog entry in confidence and submit it for your written decision within two business days of receipt. We’ll publish only after both written approval and the official selection announcement. If you withdraw the cut before announcement, we’ll delete the draft unpublished. Any proposed publicity clip or excerpt requires separate written approval and the same announcement embargo.

We will not release the cut onto a platform that keeps a 30-day backup. We also will not stand up or warrant a festival screening system. Review stays pending until the delivery path meets the deletion terms.

Use a producer-approved delivery only. We will issue individually watermarked streaming links for the three stream-only reviewers and two encrypted offline files for the two named programmers, after you have sent the five names and we have cleared them and their signed undertakings. Any backup on that path must be encrypted, inaccessible to reviewers and festival staff, and purged within 72 hours of review end or of our withdrawal notice, whichever is first. Before we issue links or files, send written confirmation from whoever operates the path that those controls are in place and that a purge certificate—time, scope, and confirmation that no residual copy remains—will be provided with the holder deletion records. If that confirmation is not available, do not upload or copy the film, and review does not start.

Withdrawal notice may come from us at any time before announcement. Same-day access disablement, 72-hour deletion of both offline copies, and the 72-hour backup purge all run from that notice, with the records already agreed. A platform retention period, however short of access, is not a substitute for the purge certificate.

Names, undertakings, watermarking, one encrypted offline copy each for two named programmers, stream-only for the other three, synopsis limits, two-business-day publicity sign-off, announcement embargo, and deletion of an unpublished catalog draft on withdrawal are agreed. The exception is not open until the delivery-path confirmation is in hand and we clear the five names. Send the names and the purge confirmation together.

We accept producer-approved delivery on those terms. Please identify the delivery operator or put us in contact with them so we can obtain their written confirmation.

We’ll send one package containing the five names, their signed undertakings, the designation of the two offline programmers, and the operator’s confirmation. The confirmation must cover backup encryption, inaccessibility to reviewers and festival staff, and purge within 72 hours of whichever comes first, review end or your withdrawal notice. It must also commit the operator to providing a purge certificate stating the time, scope, and confirmation that no residual backup copy remains. We’ll submit that certificate with the two holder deletion records.

Review remains pending until you clear the package. Until then, we’ll hold all uploads, copying and viewing.

We have not designated a delivery operator and will not name one we cannot warrant. Do not wait on us to introduce a vendor. You may propose an operator in writing; we will approve or reject that operator before any upload. Approval requires the written confirmation already specified: encrypted backup, inaccessible to reviewers and festival staff, purge within 72 hours of review end or our withdrawal notice, whichever is first, and a purge certificate stating time, scope, and that no residual backup copy remains, submitted with the two holder deletion records.

Send the five names, signed undertakings, and the two offline-programmer designations now, separately from the operator package, so we can clear the people. No links, files, uploads, copying, or viewing until both clearances are done. A substitute still needs fresh clearance and a new watermark.

Embargo trigger is the festival’s public selection announcement, not an internal programming notice. Before that announcement, and before our written approval of any text, there is no catalog entry, clip, excerpt, social post, or programmer comment that goes beyond the closed oral synopsis. That synopsis still omits the ending and any unannounced cast appearance.

Withdrawal notice is an email from us to your designated contact and is effective when sent, including before announcement and without cause. From that notice: same-day disablement of all access; deletion of both offline copies and purge of backups within 72 hours, with the holder records and purge certificate; deletion of any unpublished catalog draft or excerpt. If the board has already heard the limited synopsis, that session is not recalled, but members stay bound and receive nothing further. If we withdraw after a public announcement, already-approved published catalog text may stand unless we expressly revoke it; screeners, clips, and further excerpts come down on the same timetable. Publicity excerpts still need separate written approval, which we will give or refuse within two business days of receipt.

Designate the withdrawal-notice contact, send the names package, and send any operator proposal. The exception stays closed until we clear both.

Please direct withdrawal notices to the festival representative handling this review. We still owe you a monitored email address for that contact. We have neither the five names and signed undertakings nor an operator’s written confirmation ready to submit. We’ll send the personnel package separately as soon as it is ready, identifying the two offline programmers. The festival will source and propose the operator. Both packages require your written clearance before any links or files are issued or any upload, copying or viewing begins.

We accept that withdrawal takes effect when you send the email. We’ll disable access that day, delete the offline copies and ensure backup purge within 72 hours, provide both holder records and the operator’s purge certificate, and delete unpublished publicity drafts. Board members remain bound and receive nothing further. After public announcement, approved published catalog text may stand unless you expressly revoke it. We accept the same withdrawal timetable for screeners, clips and further excerpts.

We understand the previously agreed permission to draft a catalog entry in confidence after selection still applies so you can review the wording. Public use requires both your written approval of the material and the festival’s **public selection announcement**. We accept the two-business-day decision period and separate written approval for publicity excerpts.

The exception stays closed. We will not clear an incomplete package, and we will not treat a missing operator confirmation as a reason to relax the purge terms.

Send the monitored withdrawal-notice address before either package. Notice to that address is effective when sent, whether or not it is read. If the address is not on file when we need to withdraw, notice to the festival representative on this exchange is effective on the same basis. Name a backup recipient in the same message. Silence, an out-of-office reply, or a failed address does not delay same-day disablement, the 72-hour deletion and purge, or deletion of unpublished drafts.

The confidential catalog draft after selection may go only to one named catalog editor, identified before the draft is written, under the same undertaking. Even that draft must omit the ending and any unannounced cast appearance unless our written sign-off expressly authorizes those specifics. Sending us a draft that includes them is not clearance to retain or circulate them. Two business days means two business days in our time zone from receipt of a complete draft. No response is a refusal, not approval. A revised draft restarts the clock. Public use still requires both written approval and the festival’s public selection announcement.

Personnel names, undertakings, and the two offline designations may arrive separately and will be cleared or rejected in writing. An operator proposal is cleared only with the confirmation and purge-certificate commitment already stated. No links, files, uploads, copying, or viewing, and no catalog drafting, until the relevant clearance is actually given. Substitutes still need fresh clearance.

Those are the remaining terms. Send the notice address and backup first.

We accept the notice and catalog terms. We cannot yet provide a verified monitored email address or name a backup recipient. We’ll send both together before either clearance package. Until the address is on file, withdrawal notice sent to the festival representative on this exchange is effective when sent. We accept that silence, an out-of-office reply or delivery failure does not extend any deadline.

Review remains closed pending your written clearance of both the personnel and the delivery operator. If selected, we’ll identify one catalog editor, obtain their signed undertaking and await your clearance before drafting. The confidential draft will omit the ending and any unannounced cast appearance unless you expressly authorize those details in writing. Each complete revision starts a new two-business-day review period in your time zone. Silence counts as refusal. Public use requires both your written approval and the festival’s public selection announcement.
